payload.core_mechanism_summary: 2D DP: dp[t][i] = max sum using t selected ending at i; transition uses deque to get max of dp[t-1][j] in sliding window of size k.
payload.rationale: The code maintains arrays for current and previous layer, iterates over number of selections x, and uses deque to efficiently compute max over valid previous positions within distance k. This is classic 2D DP with sliding window optimization.
